completeness.why: getNextDate and getUpcomingDates pass their own enable flag and mode to applyWeekendRule (getNextDate's noSkipWeekend is a variation only that site has, so it may stay there); both createScheduleList sites call applyWeekendRule but keep their own outer dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? ... : ternary, so whether the rule applies is still decided there as well.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes exactly the real variation with each caller mapping its own field names (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode), with no speculative options; noSkipWeekend is left as getNextDate's explicit local override, but the template callers' redundant outer check blurs the contract.

disguised_duplication.where: The template sites' outer skipWeekend ternary is a leftover redundant check, not a reshaped copy of the rule.
